subject: HarborFinance RTO/RPO evidence handoff and SIG/CAIQ crosswalk
messages:
From: Bridget O'Neil <bridget.oneil@harborfinance.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Harbor Finance Security <security@harborfinance.com>, Ronald Kim <rkim@harborfinance.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RTO/RPO artifacts + SIG / CAIQ mapping request

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our standard onboarding and procurement we need a concise set of artifacts so our security team can validate your claimed RTO/RPOs and map them to the SIG and CAIQ controls. Specifically we're asking for:

- A one-page RTO/RPO summary that states current measured RTO and RPO for the hosted and dedicated modes (per region).
- Evidence traces that demonstrate a KV-cache warm-start within the claimed RTO (sample logs or replay traces).
- A SIG/CAIQ crosswalk: for each RTO/RPO-related control, indicate where the evidence lives.
- Proposed window for a 1-hour live witness (recorded) to observe a warm-cache replay and failover timeline.

Can you provide the artifacts by EOD Friday (16 April)? Also include any NDA/handling notes if the logs contain customer-identifying data.

Appreciate it — Bridget

--
Bridget O'Neil
Senior Security Analyst, Harbor Finance
Bridget.oneil@harborfinance.com
From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Bridget O'Neil <bridget.oneil@harborfinance.com>
Cc: Harbor Finance Security <security@harborfinance.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RTO/RPO artifacts + SIG / CAIQ mapping request

Bridget — thanks for the clear list. We're aligned and can meet the ask with some caveats around redaction. Quick notes: 

- We'll deliver a compact RTO/RPO summary (hosted / dedicated / eu/us regions) and a SIG/CAIQ crosswalk in spreadsheet form.
- For KV-cache evidence we'll provide sampled replay logs and a short runbook excerpt that shows the steps we take during warm-start. Any logs with customer identifiers will be redacted; we'll flag anything we redact.
- Live witness: we can offer a 60-minute slot on Monday 19 April between 09:00–12:00 PT. If that doesn't work we can do a recorded run and a synchronous Q&A.

Attaching a draft summary and a crosswalk template for your intake team to review.

Attachments: redwood_rto_rpo_summary.pdf, sig_caiq_crosswalk.xlsx

I copied Marissa; she'll coordinate ops evidence and ensure an engineer is available for the witness.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Security & Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 08:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: RTO/RPO artifacts + SIG / CAIQ mapping request

Kim / Jordan — forwarding Harbor's ask. Action items I'm taking:

1) KV-cache replay sample: I'll pull a sanitized log extract (kv_cache_replay_sample.log) from the April 3 warm-start test and run it through the redaction script. Expect ~2MB text file with timestamps and opcodes only.

2) Runbook excerpt & test script: I'll paste the short runbook section into the evidence packet so auditors see the exact invocation steps.

3) Witness staffing: Jordan, can you confirm an infra engineer for the 19 April 09:00 PT window? We only need someone to trigger the replay and narrate the timing; I'll handle the walk-through.

Notes for redaction: do not include customer IDs, IPs, or full request payloads. We should provide a short appendix that states what was redacted and why.

Proposed deliverables (by EOD Friday 16 Apr):
- redwood_rto_rpo_summary.pdf (one-pager)
- sig_caiq_crosswalk.xlsx (mapped rows for SIG 4.1/4.2 etc.)
- kv_cache_replay_sample.log (sanitized)
- runbook_excerpt.txt (inline in packet)
- witness_procedure.md (1-page checklist)

Jordan — can you confirm availability and whether we should provision a dedicated test env for the witness?

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Bridget O'Neil <bridget.oneil@harborfinance.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Harbor Finance Security <security@harborfinance.com>, Ronald Kim <rkim@harborfinance.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RTO/RPO artifacts + SIG / CAIQ mapping request

Hi Bridget / Harbor team —

Thanks for the request. We have attached the artifacts below and confirmed the witness slot Monday 19 Apr at 09:00 PT. If you'd prefer a different timezone window, let us know and we can adjust. Attachments are the sanitized versions; redaction notes are appended to each document.

Deliverables attached:
- redwood_rto_rpo_summary.pdf — measured RTO/RPO across clusters and a short methodology section.
- sig_caiq_crosswalk.xlsx — crosswalk rows for SOC/SIG/CAIQ controls that reference recovery and data availability.
- kv_cache_replay_sample.log — sanitized replay trace (no customer identifiers).
- runbook_excerpt.txt — excerpt of the warm-start steps and scripts.
- witness_procedure.md — one-page checklist for the live session.

HubSpot record for tracking: https://hubspot.com/deal/HF-49821
Recorded evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbcExampleDocFolder

If the security team wants additional telemetry (e.g., kernel-level IO timings or GPU warmup traces) we can provide a scoped follow-up within two business days.

Best regards,
Jordan Blake
Infrastructure Ops Lead, Redwood Inference

--

- redwood_rto_rpo_summary.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)
- sig_caiq_crosswalk.xlsx (Excel, 12 rows mapped)
